title: Time to Fake It: Continual Machine Learning Intensifies Unfairness in Deepfake Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.21974v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deepfake detectors safeguard against misinformation, rendering their failures as much a societal as a technical concern. As generators constantly evolve, detectors trained on static datasets miss newly arising threats, while progressive training interferes catastrophically. Yet, mitigating forgetfulness in terms of accuracy, the prevalent focus of continual learning (CL), is insufficient to reflect real-world impact. We therefore scrutinize the effects of CL methods with respect to evolving fairness. To this end, we analyze four dimensions of fairness across diverse demographics for detectors trained progressively on a chronological sequence of 11 real-world deepfake generation methods. Tracking fairness metrics over time, we expose non-trivial interplays between performance and fairness that depend on both the choice of CL algorithm and demographic intersections. translated_title: 伪造之时：持续机器学习加剧深度伪造检测中的不公平性
translated_abstract: 深度伪造检测器用于防范虚假信息，因此其失效不仅是技术问题，也是社会问题。随着生成器不断演进，在静态数据集上训练的检测器无法应对新出现的威胁，而渐进式训练又会引发灾难性的干扰。然而，持续学习（CL）主流关注的重点——在准确性方面缓解遗忘——并不足以反映真实世界的影响。因此，我们仔细研究了持续学习方法对公平性演化的影响。为此，我们针对在按时间顺序排列的11种真实世界深度伪造生成方法上渐进训练的检测器，分析了跨不同人口统计群体的四个公平性维度。通过随时间跟踪公平性指标，我们揭示了性能与公平性之间非平凡的相互作用，这种相互作用同时取决于持续学习算法的选择和人口统计属性的交叉性。我们发现准确性下降通常会加剧不公平性……
tldr: 该论文首次系统研究了持续学习对深度伪造检测器公平性的影响，发现在按时间顺序的11种深度伪造生成方法上渐进训练时，准确性下降通常会加剧跨人口群体（尤其是交叉性群体）的不公平现象。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically examines how continual learning affects fairness in deepfake detection, revealing that accuracy degradation during progressive training on 11 chronological deepfake generation methods typically exacerbates unfairness across demographic groups and their intersections.
